zumime: Media Type Detection from Bytes and File Names

Source: R/zumime-package.R
zumime-package.Rd

Tells what a file is from its first bytes and from its name, with no system library. Implements the 'WHATWG' 'MIME' Sniffing Standard https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/ over raw vectors and paths, inspects containers ('ZIP' entry names, 'ISO' base media brands, 'RIFF', 'EBML', 'Ogg', 'OLE2' directories) and recognises the data formats R users hold, such as 'RDS', 'Parquet', 'SQLite' and 'Stata'. Every type has a parent ending at 'application/octet-stream', and an extension table generated from the 'IANA' media types registry and the 'Apache' 'httpd' type map answers from the name. One call reports both answers, whether they agree, and whether a file is compressed, encrypted or truncated.
